troubleshootClearLogsBody: 删除本地已记录的全部运行日志文件
Delete every runtime log file recorded locally
troubleshootRecordNote: 默认关闭。开启后会在通知栏显示状态，关闭软件或手动关闭后即停止记录；日志只保存在本机，不会自动上传。
Off by default. While on, a status notification is shown and recording stops when the app closes or you turn it off; logs stay on this device and are never uploaded automatically.
troubleshootWriteStatusNote: 日志、竞速记录与流量统计由后台直接写入本地数据库。出现丢弃或打开失败时，多为数据库被长时间占用，点击可重新读取；反复出现请导出运行日志反馈。

Logs, race records and traffic statistics are written straight into the local database in the background. Dropped rows or open failures usually mean the database was locked for a long time; tap to read again, and export the runtime logs if it keeps happening.
troubleshootClearCrashesBody: 删除本地所有已记录的崩溃文件
Delete every crash file recorded locally
troubleshootCrashNote: 发生未捕获异常时自动保存诊断信息与关键日志，仅保存在设备本地，导出后可反馈给开发者。
When an uncaught exception happens, diagnostics and key logs are saved on the device only; export them to report the problem.
troubleshootCaptureWarning: 抓取运行日志会持续读写少量文件，可能导致功耗升高、存储占用增加或产生其他未知影响，不需要时请及时关闭。导出的文件可发送给开发者，配合问题现象与发生时间能更快定位原因。

Capturing runtime logs keeps reading and writing a few files, which may raise power use, increase storage usage or have other unknown effects, so turn it off when done. The exported file can be sent to the developer; describing the symptom and when it happened helps pinpoint the cause.

troubleshootStartBody:
该功能主要用于协助开发者排查问题，开启后会开始记录软件的运行日志，并持续写入本机存储。

抓取期间可能导致功耗升高、存储占用增加，或产生其他未知影响。如非排查问题所需，建议用完即关。

日志只保存在本机，关闭后停止记录；导出后你可以自行发送给开发者。

This feature mainly helps the developer diagnose problems: while on, the app's runtime logs are recorded continuously to local storage.

Capturing may raise power use, increase storage usage or have other unknown effects. Unless you are troubleshooting, turn it off when done.

Logs stay on this device and recording stops when you turn it off; you can export and send them to the developer yourself.
